instruction: Please implement a database management monitoring website to monitor the performance of MySQL databases. The website should have the functionality to monitor key MySQL metrics, such as memory usage and buffer pool size. Users should be able to log in, browse real-time monitoring data, set up custom monitoring templates, automatically discover ports that need to be monitored, and receive abnormal alarm notifications. Set plum as the body background and use dark magenta for the UI.

Please implement a trendy universe game platform that provides various trendy games and products. The platform should have features such as a trendy mall, digital trendy play, and digital creation. Users should be able to browse and purchase various products, participate in digital trendy play activities such as exchange and auction, and access trendy play strategies and new trendy play information. The platform should also provide a "digital creation" function, allowing users to participate in meta-universe construction and trendy play design. Apply bisque for layout; use dark salmon for buttons and cards.

Please implement a WeChat public account management website to manage various functions of WeChat public accounts. The website should have functionalities such as WeChat payment, template messaging, draft management, and material management. Users should be able to log in, manage the public account's menu, followers, and push messages, and directly call the WeChat payment service. The website should also have a public account migration function, allowing users to directly access the WeChat public account without having to interact with WeChat again. Use light salmon for container backgrounds and tomato for component visuals.

Please implement a high-end packaging product showcase website to display the company's high-end packaging products. The website should have functionalities for product showcase, company information, and brand integration. Users should be able to browse product images and descriptions, learn about the company, and experience the brand's overall style. The website should have a user-friendly interface and clear navigation menu, making it easy for users to find the information they need. Color the background using powder blue and set component styles to royal blue.

Please implement a review page for an anime fan community website. The page should have functionalities for displaying anime information, user reviews, and ratings. Users should be able to browse detailed anime information, view other users' reviews, post their own reviews, and rate the anime. The page should also include features such as related anime recommendations, review sorting, and filtering. Set lavender blush as the body background and use pale violet red for the UI.

Please implement a backend calculation system for calculating product costs. The system should have functionalities for product cost calculation, material library, configuration library, and price calculation. Users should be able to input ingredient information, and the system will automatically calculate the final cost information. The system should also allow users to manage the material library and configuration library, including adding, deleting, and modifying materials and configurations. Users should be able to view and print product cost reports. Apply lavender to the canvas background and blue violet to all visible components.

Please implement a cloud warehouse management system for managing storage and sales. The system should have registration and login functionality, allowing users to register and log in. The system should have features for managing inventory, sales, and procurement, allowing users to input product information, manage inventory, and perform sales and procurement operations. The system should also have query and statistical functions, enabling users to query product information, inventory status, sales status, and more. Apply light sea green as the background; style all components with medium sea green.

Please implement an anti-spam filter system to filter all incoming emails. The system should be able to filter emails independently for each email address and support multiple domain names. For unregistered senders, the system should return an email with a re-captcha verification, using the company's logo, to verify that the sender is human. If the verification is successful, the sender's address should be added to the whitelist. Implement styling with pearl for the background and charcoal for components.

Please implement a harbor form system website for submitting and approving problem forms. The website should have functionalities for form submission, approval, notification, form management, personnel management, and dashboard display. Users should be able to log in, submit problem forms, view form lists, perform approvals, manage forms and personnel, and view data statistics displayed on the dashboard. Use daisy white as the screen background and khaki for component highlights.

Please implement a recruitment platform for called Lingong and Earn Lingong, connecting employers who need to hire workers with job seekers. The platform should have functionalities for posting job tasks, recruiting personnel, self-registration, check-in, check-out, and leave applications. Employers can post job tasks, intermediate platforms can recruit personnel, job seekers can browse job requirements and register themselves, and workers can perform check-in, check-out, and leave operations. Employers and intermediate platforms can view and manage registered personnel, verify personnel work status, and make salary payments. Use smoke as the default background and midnight blue for component styling.

Please implement an educational system website that provides educational resources and services. The website should have functionalities for course management, assignment submission, and grade inquiry. Users should be able to log in, browse courses, submit assignments, inquire about grades, and communicate with teachers. Set the background color to morning mist and the component color to navy.

Please implement an RSS and Atom reader website for quick reading and subscribing to news. The website should have functionalities for subscribing, reading, and managing subscription sources. Users should be able to add, remove, and manage subscription sources, read the latest news and articles, and search and filter by category or keyword. Choose light yellow for global background and dark khaki for all components.

Please implement a website for collecting and displaying BT seed magnetic link information. The website should have the functions of collecting, storing, and displaying BT seed information. Users should be able to browse and search for collected BT seed information and view it according to different categories and filtering conditions. The website should also have data statistics and analysis functions, which can display the amount of data collected and the collection efficiency. Apply platinum for the layout background and midnight blue for interactive elements.

Please implement a WordPress blog sharing button plugin to add sharing buttons to blog posts. Users should be able to click the sharing buttons to share articles on social media platforms, such as Weibo, WeChat, Facebook, etc. The plugin should support multiple sharing platforms and allow users to customize the style and position of the sharing buttons. Set overall background to peach, then style components with orangered.

Please implement a digital name card WeChat mini-program for creating and sharing digital name cards. Users should be able to create their own digital name cards, including personal information, contact details, and social media links. Users should be able to share their digital name cards with others and view other people's digital name cards. The digital name cards should have uniqueness and security, preventing tampering and forgery. Use pearl for the background and charcoal for components.

Please implement a website with file upload, data analytics, and form generation features. The website should have a file upload feature that allows users to upload and manage files. The data analytics dashboard should display simple graphs to help users understand data trends. The form generator should be able to create custom forms that users can fill out and submit. The form submissions analyzer should analyze submitted form data to provide valuable insights. User settings and other small features should also be implemented. Implement styling with light mocha for the background and brown for components.

Please implement a global engineering information and industry chain resource integration service platform for publishing engineering information and bidding information. The platform should have functionalities for publishing domestic and foreign engineering information, bidding information, monitoring business relationships between engineering participants, and statistical investment data. Users should be able to log in, browse engineering information and bidding information, filter projects, make connections, and view target market information. Select faint peach for layout background and coral for component details.

Please implement a content management website for managing and publishing content. The website should have functionalities for hierarchical management of publications, tags, and user comments. Users should be able to log in, browse, edit, and publish content, manage user comments, and view publication history. Specify light goldenrod as the base color and goldenrod for all components.

Please implement a point-to-point instant messaging system for real-time message exchange between users. The system should have functionalities for user login, message sending, message receiving, and offline message caching. Users should be able to log in, send messages to other users, receive messages from other users, and view offline messages. When a user is offline, the system should cache messages and forward them when the user logs in. Configure all backgrounds with lavender blush and all components with pale violet red.

Please implement a digital avatar creation website for generating and customizing digital avatars. The website should have functionalities for creating avatars, customizing their appearance, and adjusting their movements and expressions. Users should be able to log in, create and customize their own avatars, adjust their appearance, movements, and expressions, and preview the effects in real-time. Specify champagne as the base color and burnt sienna for all components.

Please implement a ride-hailing type of WeChat mini-program to provide convenient travel services. The mini-program should have a driver grab-order function, which calculates the nearest driver based on the passenger's starting and ending points to grab an order, improving the passenger's travel efficiency. Users can open the mini-program, input their starting and ending points, select a car type, place an order to call a car, view the driver's location and arrival time in real-time, and communicate with the driver in real-time. Use floral white for container backgrounds and dark red for component visuals.
